elsewhere.note: “Don’t keep talking so exceedingly proudly. Don’t let arrogance come out of your mouth, for Yahweh is a God of knowledge. By him actions are weighed.
For truly my words are not false. One who is perfect in knowledge is with you.
They say, “How does God know? Is there knowledge in the Most High?”
They will not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain; for the earth will be full of the knowledge of Yahweh, as the waters cover the sea.
I will give you shepherds according to my heart, who will feed you with knowledge and understanding.
